subject: general
question: Which of the following groups is most at risk of HIV infections?

options.text: Individuals who have multiple unprotected sexual partners
People who do not exercise regularly

solution:
The correct answer is __**Individuals who have multiple unprotected sexual partners**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus)** is primarily transmitted through unprotected sexual intercourse, sharing of needles, and from mother to child during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding.
 
• **Individuals who have multiple unprotected sexual partners** are at significantly higher risk of contracting HIV due to increased exposure to potential carriers of the virus. This applies to heterosexual, homosexual, or bisexual relationships.
 
• Unprotected sexual activities can result in direct exposure to infected bodily fluids such as **semen, vaginal fluids, or blood**, which are primary carriers of the HIV virus.
